data_source: map_data.csv (10 countries in 3 groups: West=USA/UK/France/Germany/Australia, Asia=China/Japan, East=India/Russia/Brazil)

segments.name: hook
segments.text: Global alliance data has been breached. We are tracking power indexes live across the world map. Ten nations. Three alliance blocs.

segments.name: setup
segments.text: Scanning nodes globally. Watch the map calibrate to exact coordinates as each nation's power index loads in real time.

segments.name: node_1
segments.text: First up, the United States. Ninety two points on the power index. The Western bloc's undisputed leader lighting up the map.

segments.name: node_2
segments.text: United Kingdom registers seventy four points. Strong Western alliance support keeping it firmly on the global grid.

segments.name: node_3
segments.text: France locks in at seventy points. A key European node in the Western bloc maintaining steady influence.

segments.name: node_4
segments.text: Germany shows seventy two points. Industrial power backing its position as a critical Western alliance member.

segments.name: node_5
segments.text: China surges to ninety five points. The Asia bloc's absolute powerhouse. The highest index on the entire map.

segments.name: node_6
segments.text: Japan holds at seventy eight. Asia bloc's second node, carrying significant technological weight on the grid.

segments.name: node_7
segments.text: India fires up at eighty points. The Eastern bloc's growing force with unprecedented rise in global metrics.

segments.name: node_8
segments.text: Russia registers seventy six, Brazil at sixty two, and Australia at sixty eight. The remaining nodes completing the global alliance map.

segments.name: winner
segments.text: Compiling the highest influence sector now. The number one power index on the entire global map belongs to China with ninety five points.

segments.name: outro
segments.text: Transmission verified. All nodes secured. Follow for more live radar intelligence drops.
